metadata.description: Cheap, honest document ingestion for Claude Code. Converts referenced PDFs and Office files to markdown and injects a pointer, not the content - and never reports a conversion that recovered nothing.

plugins.name: markitdown-hook
plugins.description: Convert PDFs and Office documents referenced in your prompt to markdown, inject a pointer instead of the content, and grade every conversion so image-only PDFs are reported honestly rather than silently arriving empty.
